notes: One model in five drink-coloured looks. The first photo is written in full (shot is just {subject}); the other four are edits of it (from), so her face stays the same: each edit prompt says what changes and what must stay. She holds her pose frozen while a hidden turntable turns her; the jump is a bullet-time orbit with her frozen in the air, lifted off the ground on the page by air. People: fit frame, so a raised arm or a jump never shrinks anyone. The americano turned the other way and plays reversed.

turns.hold: The model holds this exact pose perfectly still, frozen like a statue, while the hidden turntable she stands on slowly rotates a full 360 degrees at a steady, even speed, always turning the same way, and ends exactly as it started. She does not move her arms, hands, legs, head or face at all, and keeps holding her drink exactly as it is. The camera is locked off: no camera movement, no zoom, no pan. The plain studio backdrop and light stay the same. Her face, hair and outfit stay exactly the same throughout.
turns.jump: Bullet-time frozen moment: time is completely stopped and the model hangs perfectly still in mid-air exactly as in the photo, her hair and clothes frozen. The view orbits a full 360 degrees around her at a steady, even speed, always the same way, and ends exactly where it started. She does not fall, land or move at all, and keeps holding her drink exactly as it is. The plain backdrop and the light stay the same. Her face, hair and outfit stay exactly the same throughout.
